name: Rise of Darkness
summary:
UNLEASH YOUR ARCHERY SKILLS

The darkness has awakened, and with it comes an unrelenting horde of undead creatures.  Prepare to embrace the shadows and defend the town against the encroaching darkness. Your archery skills will be put to the test as you face off against the army of the Risen.

NEW MAPS AND NEW CHALLENGES

Rise of Darkness expands the virtual world of Elven Assassin with three new maps. Each map presents unique challenges and strategic opportunities, ensuring that no two battles are alike.
